subject.title: [Feature]: Option to skip tool list text in system prompt (reduce duplication)

question: Should OpenClaw add a scoped opt-in config surface to suppress only the direct-mode human-readable Tooling list while leaving provider tool schemas unchanged?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds a new core prompt/config contract and overlaps with broader Tool Search/code-mode token-reduction direction.

options.title: Approve Scoped Opt-In
options.body: Add a narrowly named agent/default option that suppresses Tooling list text only in direct mode, with docs and tests proving schemas remain callable.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Token Work
options.body: Keep this open as a tracked subtask of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/14785 and decide the option alongside broader tool-schema overhead work.

options.title: Prefer Existing Compact Modes
options.body: Decline a new direct-mode config knob and direct users to Tool Search or code mode for catalog-size reductions.

recommendation.title: Approve Scoped Opt-In
recommendation.body: Add a narrowly named agent/default option that suppresses Tooling list text only in direct mode, with docs and tests proving schemas remain callable.

likelyOwner.reason: The current prompt/config history and maintainer-side issue review both point to steipete as the best available routing owner for this product/config choice.
